quote: In majority of the datasets, the common DEGs found were sterile alpha motif domain containing 9 like (SAMD9L), inhibin beta A subunit (INHBA), transmembrane protein 45A (TMEM45A) and transmembrane and tetratricopeptide repeat containing 1 (TMTC1).
